# Step 2.223, one league gate: the independent review (2026-11-25)

I read the step's line, the lane's note, T-449, T-450, T-453, T-454, S-126 and the diff against `build/stage-1`. I ran `npm run test:web` (290 checks, pass), started the built app on the made-up stand-in and sent made-up requests by hand (`.local/review-probe*.mjs`), and planted made-up files to test T-454, removing them afterwards. No code was changed. Findings, worst first:

## Medium

- **M1. A scorer who may no longer open a hidden league is told "signed out" and never gets out of it** (T-453; `apps/web/src/features/tracker/tracker-controller.ts` lines 541-543, `asksSignIn`). This is a scorer removed while scoring a draft league, or a scorekeeper of a league suspended mid-game (S-126: only owners and admins may open it). Every endpoint answers 404 `not-found`, and the tracker reads that as signed out. The banner says "You are signed out. N plays are being kept…", and renewing keeps meeting 404, so the banner never changes. Following the sign-in link while already signed in leads back to the score page, and the page gate answers that with 404, so the tracker never opens and its waiting plays are unreachable from the page. The taps are not deleted: they stay in the device's storage. Before this step the same person got 403 and the plain "not allowed" screen. Proved by reading the code and by the probe: a draft coach and a stranger get `{"error":"not-found"}` from state, rosters, format, snapshot and session. No test covers this. Not checked: whether a saved copy can still be downloaded from the signed-out banner. Fix: the plain words should cover both cases ("signed out, or this league is not open to you now"), or the tracker should ask the session once: if this is the same person, signed in, say "not allowed" and keep the taps.
- **M2. The invitation page tells a hidden league from a missing one for a signed-in person holding any token-shaped invitation cookie** (`apps/web/src/features/access-area/invitation-page.tsx` lines 70-72). For a league that exists, the page runs `readInvitation`, a database read. For a missing one it returns `NotUsable` at once. I probed as a signed-in stranger with the cookie `srl_invitation=` followed by 43 "A"s, comparing `/quiet-pines/invitation` with `/nobodyzzzzz/invitation`. The bodies matched, but the hidden league's answer carried an extra `Link: …057awfv589fke.css; rel=preload` header in 2 of 3 tries (so did the live league's), and the missing one's never did. It also costs one more read, which a real database will show as time. `everyWaySameAsNoLeague` only asks for the invitation page with no cookie, so it misses this. The flaw was not added by this step, but it sits on the step's promise that every way into a league answers alike. Fix: read the invitation for `noLeagueId` too, as T-449 does, and add this cookie case to the check.
- **M3. T-454 can be fooled** (`scripts/structure/league-gate.mjs`). I planted made-up files and ran `node scripts/check.mjs`. Not caught: (a) a route that re-exports its handlers (`export { GET, POST } from '…'`), because `defined` only finds `export function` and `export const`; (b) an `OPTIONS` or `HEAD` handler that reads the body, because only GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE are looked at; (c) a server action written inline (`'use server'` inside a function in a page), because `isUseServer` only reads the top of the file; (d) an action that calls `loadLeaguePage(` only under an `if`, or after its work, because the rule checks only that the call appears somewhere, not when it runs. By reading the regex, not planted: a body read through a parameter not named `request` (`req.json()` before the gate) is also missed, because `bodyReads` looks only for `request.`. Every route and action today is gated (checked by reading), so nothing is open now. Fix: refuse re-exports and any other exported name in a league route, and look for `'use server'` anywhere in the file.
- **M4. A draft league's plain scorekeeper is not proved by any test** (`tests/browser/draft-scorer-taps-test.mjs` line 13 signs in `local-admin-token`; `league-gate-hidden.test.ts` has no scorekeeper). The plan's done test asks that "a draft league's scorekeeper still scores a game". By hand, `local-scorekeeper-token` at the draft league got 200 from state, rosters, format, snapshot and the score page, and `held-by-you` from session, so the product works today. Nothing would stop a later change from breaking it. Add a scorekeeper row (a draft and a suspended league) to `league-gate-hidden.test.ts`.

## Low

- **L1. Timing below the gate** (T-449's stated gap; `packages/core/src/modules/access/queries/my-access.ts`). For a missing league, `isSignedInHere` stops after one read. A hidden one costs three (the owner twice, then the grants). On the stand-in (signed-in stranger, 300 tries each, in turn) the median was 3.99 ms against 3.79 ms for `state`, and 8.34 ms against 8.39 ms for the home page, which is noise. On a real database it is two more round trips, a few milliseconds that many tries can measure. Low, because all it gives away is that a guessed short name is taken, which signing up for a league's address probably shows anyway (not verified).
- **L2. The API half of `everyWaySameAsNoLeague` never asks that the missing side be 404** (`scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` near the `api` loop). The pages and the "my team" actions do ask. If both sides crashed with the same 500, the routes would pass. The comparison itself is real. I made only the visitor's GET of `state` answer 401 at a hidden league in `league-api.ts`, rebuilt and ran `test:web`: it failed with exactly four lines, draft and suspended, status and body. Then I put the code back (`.next` now holds that broken build, so the next `test:web` must rebuild).
- **L3. Old tracker pages** (T-453). A page opened before this step reads `{"error":"unknown-game"}` as no answer and keeps retrying: it holds the taps but never says the game is gone. Signed out at a hidden league, the old page reads the gate's `not-found` as the game gone and sets the taps aside, listed as not saved but kept. That only happens to a page open across the release in a draft league. `apps/live-stats` is not changed and does not use `@srleagues/contracts`, so it is untouched.
- **L4. `draft-scorer-taps-test` is sound**. It is not passing on a timeout: the 90 s wait throws into `step`, which records a failure. The "signed in again" checks read the server's snapshot and the device's storage, not only the screen. One weak spot: "never said to be gone" is counted once, right after the banner appears, so the message could show up later unseen.

## What held

Each of these answered the same as a missing league: capitals (`/Quiet-Pines`, `/QUIET-PINES/teams`), the old name `/quiet-pine` (pages, admin, invitation), an id in capitals on the API, `score/manifest.webmanifest`, `score/tracker-worker.js` and `invitation/{token}` (both 303 to their own address). `unknown-game` came only from past the gate: the owner got it for a missing game, while a coach and a stranger got `not-found`. A suspended league's scorekeeper got 404 at the score page.

Not done: running the same requests on `build/stage-1` side by side (no second build). That answers for people who may open the league are unchanged rests on reading the code: the gate adds only `mayOpenLeague` and hands on the `holder` it read.
